learning_outcomes.text: Study of object representation methods, procedures for developing graphic documentation for industrial products, and the use of a computer-aided graphic environment specific to the engineering field.

syllabus_topics: 3D models for complex parts and their transposition using generic graphics into plane projections
Modeling and generation of execution drawings with interactive solutions, analysis, design
Modeling of a simple assembly. Using assembly constraints. Automatic generation of 2D documentation, dimensioning, positioning, component table. Micro motor
3D models and 2D documentation for a medium complexity assembly; car suspensions. Mini project

assessment_methods.method: Presentation of portfolio of works and synthesis projects

assessment_rules: The minimum performance standard involves preparing the necessary graphic documentation for a medium-complexity assembly (Micromotor).
